name: Charles Bridge
description: A historic stone bridge lined with statues links Prague’s Old Town and Lesser Town over the Vltava.

name: Prague Castle
description: A vast castle complex crowns the hill with St. Vitus Cathedral and palace courtyards.

name: Old Town Hall Astronomical Clock
description: The medieval astronomical clock draws hourly crowds on Old Town Square.

name: Český Krumlov Castle
description: A riverside castle and baroque theatre overlook the winding Vltava in South Bohemia.

name: Sedlec Ossuary
description: A chapel decorated with human bones sits beneath Sedlec’s cemetery church.

name: Bohemian Switzerland
description: Sandstone towers and gorges fill a national park shared with Germany’s Saxon Switzerland.

name: Karlštejn Castle surroundings
description: A Gothic castle above a village west of Prague, popular for day hikes and tours.

name: Moravian Karst
description: Caves and the Macocha gorge draw visitors north of Brno.

name: Lednice–Valtice Cultural Landscape
description: Palaces, parks and follies form a designed landscape in South Moravia.

name: Petřín Hill
description: Gardens, a lookout tower and funicular sit above Malá Strana.

name: Havel’s Market
description: A central open market sells produce, flowers and snacks near Old Town.

name: Náplavka farmers’ market
description: Weekend stalls line the Vltava embankment with local producers and street food.

name: Zelný trh
description: Brno’s cabbage market square has hosted produce sellers for centuries.

name: Pilsner Urquell Brewery
description: The birthplace brewery of pale lager offers tours and tastings in Plzeň.

name: Ostrava city market halls
description: Market halls and pubs serve Silesian and Czech classics in Ostrava’s centre.

name: Signal Festival
description: An autumn festival of light art installations across Prague streets and façades.
